sections.label: Repair order (always this sequence)
items: 1. Strip a markdown code fence if present.
4. Validate the parsed object against the schema.
Never validate before you've successfully parsed.

sections.label: What repair CAN fix
items: A markdown fence wrapped around otherwise-valid JSON.
A single trailing comma before a closing brace/bracket.
A trailing newline after valid JSON (whitespace is ignored by `json.loads()`).

sections.label: What repair CANNOT fix
items: Prose that never attempted JSON at all: there's no structure to repair.
A field with the wrong TYPE (a string where a number was required): that's a validation failure, not a parse failure.
A missing required field: same, a validation failure.

sections.label: Decision rule
items: Parse fails after repair → escalate to an expensive model retry with the error included.
Parse succeeds, schema fails → reject with a structured error naming the specific field.

sections.label: Common mistakes
items: Stripping the trailing comma AFTER attempting `json.loads()` instead of before.
Silently defaulting a missing required field instead of rejecting.
Treating prose-only output the same as a fixable syntax defect.

sections.label: Implementation checklist
checklist: A parse failure returns a structured error, never raises uncaught.
A validation failure names the specific missing/wrong-typed field.
